reason: I only do gummies or drinks, I really don't like swallowing pills, and this is 2 capsules every night. My doctor did say my magnesium could be low, so I get why I'd want it, but capsules are a no for me.
objection: It's capsules. I don't swallow pills, so I'd end up with 28 sachets in a drawer. The lab report is nice, but it doesn't fix that.
would_change_my_mind: A gummy or drink version with the same lab-tested report and a known dose.
